turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: This is Devon from Northwind Recovery. This is an attempt to collect a debt and any information obtained will be used for that purpose. This call is recorded.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I've told you people I can't pay right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The balance is nineteen hundred dollars. When can you pay?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I don't know. I lost my job in March.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If you don't pay this week we'll take you to court and garnish your wages.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You can't do that. I'm going to file a complaint.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's your right, but the balance stands.

labels.notes: Disclosures correct; the violation is the threat itself.
